Direct point counts over F11/F17 independently agree. The finite checks do not replace the general line parametrization and descent argument.

value.rationale: An explicit complete joint arithmetic refinement of the distinguished Clebsch configuration across every coordinate-permutation finite-field twist. It records all minimal definition fields for 27 lines and ten Eckardt points while identifying the exceptional fifth-root sign summand in Picard action. Cases with zero rational lines but an Eckardt point and cases with the same line splitting but different surface point counts motivate the exact classification beyond generic Weyl tables.
